messages:
Maya R: quick sync — runtime perf sprint status. Need clear owners for the KV eviction tuning and the kernel backport into release-5. Who's taking what?

Ashwin G: I can take the kernel backport. PR at https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/512 — it's mostly the attention-fusion changes. CI is green locally, but the e2e still flakes on long-seq tests. ETA EOW if no surprises.

Jenna C: I'll own the KV eviction tuning in user-facing config, but need clarity on the feature-flag path. Is this going via ff-service or a per-cluster toggle? cc @Samir P

Samir P: I can handle the feature flag wiring. We'll route through ff-service so product can toggle per-team. Dependency: eng-infra needs the canary subnet ready for the 2-hour rollout window.

Maya R: perfect. Ashwin: post a short checklist in the PR description for the backport (bench numbers, risk, roll-back steps). Jenna/Samir: add the flag name and default behavior to the runtime runbook.

Ashwin G: added checklist to PR now. Small bench note: attention-fusion reduces p50 decode by ~8% on A100 for seq-2048, but increases prefill CPU a bit. Putting numbers in the PR comment.

Alex L: quick review pinged on the PR. Can someone from eng-sre sanity-check the prefill CPU spike? @ops-bot can you link the telemetry dashboard?

ops-bot: dashboard link https://dash.internal/redwood/runtime/prefill-cpu — last 24h baselines attached.

Jenna C: noted. On the KV side: proposed default eviction window = 10m, aggressive TTL = 2m for low-RPS models. Sample config snippet I'm going to add:
```
kv_cache:
  default_ttl: 600  # seconds
  aggressive_ttl: 120
  eviction_policy: lru_async
```

Samir P: canary plan: 10% traffic to canary pool (gpu-dedicated-canary), monitor token-latency, cache hitrate, and OOMs for 3h. If steady, escalate to 50% for 6h, then full. I need eng-infra signal to spin the pool up at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

Maya R: agreed. Owners: Ashwin = kernel backport, Jenna = KV config and runbook, Samir = FF + canary rollout. Action items: update tracker card, link PRs, and sanity dashboards. If you don't update by EOD tomorrow I'll reassign.

Alex L: I'll do the eng-sre sanity checks after the canary pool is up. Leaving a small note: please include rollback tag `rb/kv-evict-2026-03` in deploys.

Jenna C: copied. One last question — any perf regression tests we should run pre-canary? I can run local microbench + a short perf harness.

Ashwin G: run `bazel run //bench:decode_longseq --runs=5` and gather p50/p95. I'll add a CI job to gate the backport once green.

Maya R: thanks all. I'll move this into the sprint tracker and tag owners. Short async Qs ok here, otherwise we'll meet in tomorrow's 1:1. :thumbsup:
